description: Obsidian Publish publishes this vault in place. Canonical publication records are included; the named support/provenance surfaces below are excluded even though they share the vault root.

include.default: all markdown under the vault root that is not matched by exclude

exclude.reason: internal quilts and pre-propagation ledgers — supporting, not public publication body
quilt-pending reference-notes shelf — provenance, not public depth
Frank-authored source-house encounter notes — readable in-repo, never public
legacy Notes filename guard; renamed houses use <source_id>-NOTES.md
generated navigation audit JSON — machine mirror, not a reader page

operator_binding.headless_site_options: ob publish-site-options --index-file README.md --show-navigation true --show-graph true --show-outline true --show-search true --show-backlinks true --show-hover-preview true --show-theme-toggle true --sliding-window true
operator_binding.note: Apply exclude patterns through the Publish path filters or equivalent headless flags so the locked surfaces never leave the private vault.

authority: WRITING-PROTOCOL.md §16 Public Git and clean-release discipline
